companies.name: Yoti

companies.name: Onfido (an Entrust company)

companies.name: Jumio

companies.notes: No major public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: ID.me

companies.name: Sumsub
companies.description: Global KYC/AML and identity verification provider widely used by cryptocurrency exchanges and fintechs.

companies.name: Trulioo

companies.name: Persona

companies.notes: No major public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: AgeChecked
companies.description: UK-based age verification service used for age-restricted online sales and access control.
companies.notes: Included for completeness given role in UK/EU age-verification compliance; no confirmed breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: VerifyMy (VerifyMyAge)
companies.description: UK-based age assurance provider offering age estimation and age verification for online platforms.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: IDnow
companies.description: German identity verification provider offering video identification and automated eKYC across the EU.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: WebID
companies.description: German provider of video identification and eSignature identity verification services.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: IDology (a GBG company)
companies.description: US identity verification and fraud prevention company, part of GBG Group, serving financial services and age-restricted commerce.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: LexisNexis Risk Solutions
companies.description: US risk-management and identity-data aggregator offering KYC/AML and ID verification products (ThreatMetrix, InstantID) and healthcare patient identity management.
companies.notes: No confirmed direct breach of ID-verification data identified as of research date; monitored given scale of identity data holdings.

companies.name: Experian (Identity/KYC products)
companies.description: Global credit bureau offering identity verification and KYC data products alongside credit reporting, including patient identity verification for healthcare.
companies.notes: Experian has had unrelated consumer data-exposure incidents historically; no ID-verification-specific breach confirmed as of research date.

companies.name: AU10TIX
companies.description: Israeli identity-verification technology vendor providing document and biometric verification behind the scenes for major platforms including TikTok, Uber, X, and LinkedIn.
companies.notes: Admin credentials to a logging platform were exposed online for over a year, reported by 404 Media in June 2024.

companies.name: IDMerit
companies.description: California-based AI-powered identity verification provider serving financial services and fintech platforms across 200+ countries.
companies.notes: An unsecured MongoDB database was discovered exposed to the public internet in November 2025, disclosed publicly in February 2026.

companies.name: Fractal ID
companies.description: Web3-focused KYC/identity verification provider used by crypto exchanges and DeFi platforms.
companies.notes: Confirmed unauthorized API access in July 2024 affecting roughly 0.5% of its user base.

companies.name: Signzy
companies.description: India-based (Bengaluru) provider of digital KYC and identity-verification infrastructure for banks and fintechs.
companies.notes: Confirmed infostealer malware incident in late 2024; major banking clients stated their customer data was unaffected.

companies.name: Discord (Age Verification / Trust & Safety vendor)
companies.description: Global chat and community platform; not a dedicated ID-verification vendor, but processes government ID images for age verification via third-party support tooling.
companies.notes: Breach occurred via a compromised third-party customer-support (Zendesk) system, not Discord's core infrastructure.

companies.name: MyGiftCardSupply
companies.description: US online gift-card retailer that collects customer ID documents to comply with anti-money-laundering (KYC) rules.
companies.notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor, but included because it directly stored KYC identity documents that were exposed.

companies.name: Transak (third-party KYC vendor incident)
companies.description: Fiat-to-crypto payment gateway whose third-party KYC vendor was compromised via a phishing attack.
companies.notes: The breach originated at a third-party KYC vendor used by Transak, not at a named public identity-verification brand.

companies.name: Nefos (PuffPal)
companies.description: European platform (PuffPal) providing membership management and age verification for cannabis social clubs and retailers.
companies.notes: Systems hosting age-verification documents for cannabis-club members were left unprotected on the public internet.

companies.name: Tea (Tea Dating Advice app)
companies.description: US women's dating-safety app that required selfie and government-ID verification at signup.
companies.notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor; included because it directly collected and exposed verification selfies and ID photos.

companies.name: Incode
companies.description: US-based identity verification platform offering biometric onboarding, liveness detection, and reusable digital identity for fintech, gig-economy, healthcare, and government clients.

companies.name: Socure
companies.description: US identity verification and fraud-prevention platform combining data intelligence, document verification, and machine learning risk scoring.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Mitek Systems
companies.description: US provider of mobile document capture and biometric identity verification technology (Mobile Verify) used by banks and fintechs worldwide.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: TransUnion

companies.name: Signicat

companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: SecureKey Technologies

companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: HyperVerge
companies.description: India-based AI identity verification platform offering document verification, face matching, and liveness detection for fintech and telecom clients globally.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: SEON

companies.description: UK-based identity verification and AML compliance platform offering document verification, biometric checks, and ongoing monitoring.

companies.name: Berbix (Socure)

companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Bouncer Digital

companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Privately

companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Coinbase
companies.description: US-based cryptocurrency exchange requiring KYC verification including government IDs, selfies, and addresses for account compliance.
companies.notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor; included because a bribed third-party support contractor exfiltrated KYC and personal data.

companies.description: French national government agency operating the database of identity documents (passports, national ID cards, driving licences) for French citizens.

companies.name: Eurail / Interrail (Eurail Group)
companies.description: European rail-pass provider that collects passport numbers and personal data from travellers for identity verification and pass issuance.
companies.notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor; included because it directly stored passport data that was exposed in a breach.

companies.name: UK Visa Portal (ETA-Pass)
companies.description: Third-party website (also known as UK Visit / ETA-Pass) that processed UK visa/ETA applications requiring passport and selfie uploads.

companies.name: RENAPER (Argentina)
companies.description: Argentina's National Registry of Persons, the government agency responsible for issuing national ID cards (DNI) and maintaining the national identity database.

companies.name: Aadhaar (UIDAI, India)
companies.description: India's Unique Identification Authority, operator of the Aadhaar biometric national ID system used for identity verification across government and private services.
companies.notes: Government biometric ID authority; included due to multiple large-scale reported data exposures linked to the Aadhaar ecosystem.

companies.name: BankID (Sweden) / CGI
companies.description: Sweden's dominant bank-backed digital identity and authentication system (BankID), with supporting infrastructure built by IT contractor CGI.

companies.name: National ID (Bangladesh)

companies.notes: Government identity database; included due to a large-scale reported public exposure of citizen NID data.

companies.name: CLEAR (CLEAR Secure)

companies.description: Dutch digital identity provider offering secure authentication and identity verification for healthcare, government, and enterprise sectors across Europe.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: IDENTOS
companies.description: Identity verification platform offering government-strength biometric and document verification toolsets for healthcare patient and proxy identity checks.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: VerifiNow
companies.description: US biometric identity verification vendor offering PatientVerifi, a voice/facial/liveness platform for telehealth patient authentication integrated with Zoom and Microsoft Teams.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Worldcoin (Tools for Humanity)
companies.description: Biometric iris-scanning digital identity project (World ID) developed by Tools for Humanity, aiming to provide proof-of-personhood verification globally.
companies.notes: No confirmed data breach identified as of research date; included given scale of biometric data collection and ongoing regulatory scrutiny in multiple countries.

companies.name: CLEAR Plus
companies.description: CLEAR's consumer-facing biometric expedited-screening product used at US airports and stadiums, verifying identity via fingerprint and iris/facial scans.
companies.notes: Distinct entry from CLEAR's healthcare (CLEAR1) product line to reflect its separate consumer identity database; no confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: NEC Corporation
companies.description: Japanese multinational technology company offering biometric identity verification (facial, iris, fingerprint recognition) via its NEC Identity Cloud Service for governments, financial institutions, and enterprises across Asia-Pacific.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Megvii
companies.description: Chinese AI company (developer of Face++) providing facial recognition and biometric identity verification technology used in Chinese and regional identity-verification deployments.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: SenseTime
companies.description: Chinese AI company providing facial recognition and biometric identity verification technology, partnering regionally to extend smart-city and identity verification services across Asia-Pacific.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: OnGrid
companies.description: India-based background verification and KYC platform offering digital identity checks for employment and financial-services onboarding.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Trusting Social
companies.description: Singapore-headquartered digital identity company (Trust Vision) offering facial recognition eKYC, selfie-to-ID matching, and cross-database identity verification across Southeast Asia.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Cynopsis Solutions
companies.description: Singapore-based RegTech company offering KYC, AML screening, and compliance automation for financial institutions in Southeast Asia.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: SurePass
companies.description: India-based identity verification API provider offering Aadhaar, PAN, and document-based KYC verification for Indian fintechs.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Accura Scan

companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: BioVerify
companies.description: New Zealand-based biometric AML/CFT identity verification provider offering safe-harbour data-source coverage for New Zealand and Australia.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Cyberlinks
companies.description: Japanese company operating the country's official public personal authentication platform using government-issued ID cards for eKYC, with a dominant position in Japan's digital identity market.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Duc App (Duales)
companies.description: Toronto-based Canadian fintech money-transfer app (Duc) serving immigrant communities, requiring driver's licenses, passports, and selfies for KYC identity verification.
companies.notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor; included because it directly stored and exposed customer KYC identity documents.

companies.name: Pay Tel Communications
companies.description: US corrections-industry vendor providing phone, tablet, and communications services to jail and prison inmates, requiring ID document uploads from those wishing to communicate with inmates.

companies.name: Tabiq
companies.description: Hotel check-in system used at multiple hotels in Japan, relying on facial recognition and passport/ID document scanning to verify guest identity at check-in.

companies.name: NYC Health + Hospitals

companies.name: UAE Pass
companies.description: United Arab Emirates' national digital identity system offering biometric (face) login and a single sign-on used across more than 6,000 government and private services, with over 5 million users.

companies.name: EguWallet
